item.title: Unleashing the Power of Elasticsearch on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
item.description: Introduction Link to heading With the increasing prevalence of big data solutions, it’s crucial for developers and engineers to understand technologies like Elasticsearch and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Elasticsearch, an open-source full-text search and analytics engine, is built on Apache Lucene and is known to handle large volumes of data in near real-time. On the other hand, GKE is a managed, production-ready environment for deploying containerized applications. It stands out in its dynamic scalability, high availability, and secure multi-tenant architecture.
